purpose: Source provenance, safe identity findings, and bounded acceptance evidence for southern research leads; no raw parcel geometry or owner fields retained.

sources.publisher: Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO), State of Indiana / IndianaMap
sources.identitySemantics: Official IGIO harvest/service metadata defines LOCAL_ID as the local identifier for each feature if supplied by a county, SOURCE_FEATUREID as the county source feature ID, and STATE_PARCEL_ID as the statewide parcel feature identifier. For the repeated state_parcel_id 491112237030000101, the two records share parcel_id and safe locality/classification metadata but have different local_id values (1050337, 1383056), NGUID values, source_featureid values (309214, 309213), and distinct adjacent/slightly overlapping polygon metrics (~2494 and ~1161 m2). Use the county-supplied per-feature local_id as identity; preserve state_parcel_id as display/tax parcel key. No grouping or geometry parts policy inferred.

sources.publisher: EBRGIS; East Baton Rouge Parish Assessor's Office; Department of Information Services.
sources.semantics: Official EBRGIS layer metadata says tax-parcel features can represent a single lot or group of lots held under one taxpayer account. Accordingly the descriptor explicitly configures complete same-key assessor-account geometry groups as parts; this is not a claim that an account equals one legal parcel.
